original_card.question: Can a legal decoder or coframe change improve the full signed moment, including changed helper targets?
methods: Construct and independently check one source-bound instance of the stated first experiment.
Seek an exact counterexample or target-specific complete-budget obstruction to that same proposed change.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A source-bound arbitrary-input identity and legal producer/consumer boundary with the complete paid and productive target invoice, including restoration, ownership, native alignment and extra charges. Price under the actual current model; historical ceiling.py assumptions must be established before use. A favorable optimistic relaxation keeps a route open but is not a completed supplier. A scoped local result remains useful; expansion requires the family-level budget gate.

actual_scope: On the pinned round-three centre word, the one-way move of every rank-8 Y exit onto frame 1 is not an accepted endpoint of the retained chart tuple. The same move, under the changed tuple that replaces exactly those exits by frame 1 and keeps every other final chart, preserves the linear operator and raises the paid moment by exactly 112 at every exponent in (0, 1]. The predecessor gap of at least 48 still prices that chart replacement only together with an optimistic deletion of the eight centre transports.
scope_change_reason: The card asks whether a decoder or coframe change improves the signed moment. This package does not build that decoder. It answers the one-way frame-1 endpoint question left open by research/y-exit-rank-lift-obstruction and by open PR #7102, on the #4610 round-three word rather than on the selected #7000 word.
bottleneck_link: A favourable complex itinerary has to clear a complete signed bill at a legal endpoint. The retained endpoint rejects this move. The endpoint that accepts it raises the paid moment by 112 and does not improve the selected exponent.
stop_rule: Stop once the retained chart tuple is shown to reject the one-way move and the frame-1 replacement tuple is shown to raise the paid moment by exactly the number of moved exits. Do not search a dimension-changing warp, and do not change the selected frontier.
evidence: python3 -B research/y-exit-one-way-frame1-endpoint/verify.py prints PASS_Y_EXIT_ONE_WAY_FRAME1_ENDPOINT. PROOF.md records the chart comparison, the endpoint rejection, and both moment comparisons. The checker replays role 112 and all 112 exits.

open_questions.why_it_matters: With helper finals frozen, those roles are already at their net variation, so they cannot pay for the added 112 rank-1 children. A lower helper final would be a further endpoint change.
open_questions.first_step: Name one helper role, its emitted final chart, and one legal nested destination of lower dimension, then replay the scalar pins and compare rank mass with 112.
open_questions.blocked_by: No such destination is constructed. The emitted helper walks already meet the variation lower bound, and lowering the final chart abandons that helper's retained endpoint.
